items.name: Axe of a Thousand Metals
description: Right-click to attack in an large arc
Shift-right-click to slam the ground and create a shockwave

items.name: Earthrend Gauntlet
description:
Boulder Lift
Right-click earthen ground to lift a boulder
Punch boulder to fire it as projectile
Charge right-click to lift bigger boulders

Tunnel
Right-click the air to start tunneling through the ground
Hold right-click and look in the direction you'd like to dig
Release right-click to surface and stop tunneling

Pillar Rise
Hold both Sneak and Jump to rise upward on a pillar of earth
The pillar's width increases if it grows through geomancy boulders

items.name: Geomancer Staff
description: Spawns three small rocks that fire as projectiles after a delay
Look in the direction you want the rocks to fire, then right-click

items.name: Infernal Forge
description: When in your main hand, right click at a block to cause AOE damage

items.name: Spear
description: 1/3 chance to instantly kill animals with less than 30 health

items.name: Void Forge
description: When in main hand, right click at a block to summon Void Runes in a fan shape

items.name: Ancient Spear
description: Left click to shoot a Sandstorm

items.name: Arcanethyst
description: Chance on hit to levitate your target.
For a short duration, lift nearby medium-sized enemies with arcane force, then slam them into the ground.

items.name: Astrape
description: Right click to shoot a Lightning Spear

items.name: Awakened Lichblade
description: Tortured souls radiate from you, damaging any nearby enemies.
Command your souls to attack a distant target, dealing rapid damage. Chance to siphon health.
After the attack subsides, your souls return to you and, when reaching you, grant you absorption.

items.name: Bloodwake
description: Hits inflict Bleed. Striking an enemy at maximum Bleed consumes it in a blood burst and grants Blood Frenzy.
The burst damages nearby enemies and inflicts Bleed around the target.
Blood bursts and blood waves stain the ground, slowing enemies and healing you while you stand in the blood.
Consume all Blood Frenzy to invoke one of five blood rites.
More Frenzy invokes stronger rites: wake, scream, spectral blades, blood flies, and the Red Tide.

items.name: Bramblethorn
description: Unique Effect: Grasp of the Wild
On hit, send a bramble from your previous target to your current target, damaging and slowing enemies in its path.
Send forth a living bramble that binds the target and nearby enemies together.
Damage dealt to one bound enemy echoes through the others.

items.name: Brimstone Claymore
description: Chance on hit to spew forth explosive brimstone.
Summon a Brimstone Claymore above the target that pulses area damage before plunging into the ground.

items.name: Caelestis
description: Tear open a breach into another dimension, summoning corrupted creatures that fight for you.
The breach lasts 45s and expands to a 20 block radius.
It collapses over its final 5s, pulling the summons back to their dimension. Each breach has a 5% chance to release an Unbound creature that hunts you.

items.name: Ceraunus
description: When used while sneaking, it summons Waves in a Fan pattern

items.name: Chomp'olotl
description: Axolotls attack nearby enemies, and can be perched on your shoulders to provide area buffs.

items.name: Cursed Bow
description: If it's a special arrow, two shots will be fired.

items.name: Dawnquiver
description: A lesser bow periodically fires at the most distant enemy you can see, and has a 35% chance to grant Dawn Chorus.
Store up to 3 Chorus on this weapon.
Hold to draw a great bow of light, firing an arrow based on your release timing and Dawn Chorus charges.
Dawn Volley - Spend 1 Chorus to loose a second arrow. 2.5s CD.
Sunlance - Spend 2 Chorus to pierce up to four enemies. 5.0s CD.
Seraphic Chorus - Spend 3 Chorus to summon three converging bows. 7.5s CD.

items.name: Decaying relic
description: A faint power seems to emanate from within.

items.name: Dormant Relic
description: A faint power seems to emanate from within.

items.name: Dreadwhisper
description: Targets struck by Shadow Rend suffer a Corrupted Wound for 10.0s.
Striking a wounded target with Dreadwhisper guarantees a critical hit and ruptures the wound.
Become a wall of dark energy, surge through enemies, and leave Gloam in your wake.
Each enemy in the path takes a weapon hit, suffers a Corrupted Wound, and heals you for 35% of the health removed.
Gloam slows and latches onto enemies that linger within it. Hostile deaths feed its growth.

items.name: Emberblade
description: Channel energy into the blade. Upon release, send forth fiery hot shrapnel at your aimed target, dealing increased damage the longer the channel.
Releasing the channel within the last second allows you to fire an additional piece of shrapnel.
When releasing shrapnel, you have a chance relative to your channel time to gain Speed, Haste, and Strength.

items.name: Emberlash
description: Attacking enemies inflicted with Smouldering causes you to deal an additional 0.2 damage per stack.
Evade backwards while cauterising your wounds, healing for 15.0% of Max HP.

items.name: Enigma
description: While you are near to your twister, gain Haste.
Summon a twister that chases down nearby enemies, dealing increased damage the longer an enemy remains trapped within.

items.name: Flamewind
description: When a flame seed detonates, gain Haste.
Plant a seed of flame within the nearest enemy, dealing damage over time.
Upon expiring, the seed detonates, dealing area damage and spreading the effect to nearby enemies.

items.name: Frostfall
description: Throw Frostfall forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
After landing, Frostfall pulses 5 times, damaging, slowing,  and pulling enemies.

items.name: Gauntlet of Bulwark
description: Hold right click for 1 second to push nearby entities and inflict Blazing Brand
Release to charge forward and damage entities in front

items.name: Gauntlet of Guard
description: When in your main hand, right click to pull entities

items.name: Gauntlet of Maelstrom
description: Right click to summon a Void Vortex

items.name: Gloampiercer
description: Swing toward an enemy 3–12 blocks away to summon an airborne shadow clone that hurls an explosive spear at the target.
Rise into the air and command shadow clones to bombard the targeted area with Gloam spears.
Gloam slows and latches onto enemies that linger within it. Hostile deaths feed its growth.

items.name: Harbinger
description: Chance on hit to inflict weakness.
Summons an Abyssal Battle Standard that pulls, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting haste to friendly players within its vicinity.

items.name: Hearthflame
description: Unique Effect: Chains of the Furnace
Weapon hits can brand and ignite enemies, making them easier to bind with furnace chains.
Bind nearby enemies with molten chains. Striking bound enemies echoes fire damage to other bound enemies.
As the chains are stretched, they build pressure. Attacking bound enemies also builds pressure.
At maximum pressure, your next strike shatters every remaining chain, dealing area damage.

items.name: Hippocampus Slapper
description: Dazes and slows targets; it's quite confusing to be hit with a fish tail

items.name: Hippogryph Talon Sword
description: Always slashes target, dealing extra damage
Every use of it is a sweeping attack

items.name: Hiveheart
description: Release an angry bee on hit that stings your target before disappearing.
This effect can only occur once every 3s.
Release a swarm of tiny bees to harass nearby enemies, slowing and damaging them repeatedly.

items.name: Icewhisper
description: While wielded, gain a frost aura that deals damage and slows enemies within 4.0 blocks.
Ice comets crash down around you for a duration, dealing area damage where they land.

items.name: Ionbound Stormscale
description: Periodically generate up to 3 Ion Cubes while wielded.
When receiving a single large hit of damage, consume an ion cube to negate the damage and surround yourself with a protective field for 2 seconds.
Consume a cube to create an ion corridor that pushes enemies inward before slamming shut.
Activate again within 1 second of the slam to consume another cube and channel a steerable energy beam for 3 seconds, repeatedly damaging and paralysing enemies for 5 seconds.
Your movement and aim are greatly slowed while channelling the beam.

items.name: Lightning Dragon Bone Sword
description: +4 damage against Fire Dragons and Ice Dragons

items.name: Livyatan
description: Has innate Loyalty III. Weapon swings release a damaging wave.
Throw Livyatan forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
On return, Livyatan creates a wave that pulls enemies, and has a chance to strike them with lightning.

items.name: Longsword of the Plague
description: Weapon hits inflict the target with fever. At 5 fever, a plague bell tolls and damages nearby enemies.
The toll spreads fever and can cascade through up to 6 enemies.
Hits can convert positive effects into ailments, granting bonus fever and empowering the next toll.

items.name: Magiblade
description: The Magiblade occasionally detects and repels approaching enemies.
After charging, summon a Warden head that orbits you for 15.0 seconds and periodically fires sonic waves at nearby enemies. Using the ability again refreshes its duration.

items.name: Magiscythe
description: Attacking enemies while Magistorm is active grants a chance to repair an equipped item.
A localised magical storm manifests above you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Each time the storm strikes, it has a chance to refresh its duration and increases its severity.

items.name: Magispear
description: Chance on hit to deal additional magic damage.
Launch the Magispear skyward, calling down a rain of magic spears that damage enemies.
When the spear rain ends, leap to the target area to deliver a final slam attack.

items.name: Meat Shredder
description: Right-click damages entities in front (i-frame ignore)

items.name: Mjolnir
description: Weapon hits cause enemies to become Conductive.
Summon a mobile storm that repeatedly strikes nearby enemies before ending in a powerful thunderclap.
Conductive enemies release a smaller thunderclap when struck.

items.name: Molten Edge
description: Dealing or receiving damage builds Heat, increasing damage dealt and received.
At maximum Heat, deal 50% more damage, take 100% more damage, and become ignited.
Heat is lost when Molten Edge is no longer wielded.
Vent the stored heat, creating a molten shockwave. While venting, weapon swings release magma ruptures.

items.name: Phantasmal Blade
description: Fires a spinning sword that travels through blocks

items.name: Ribboncleaver
description: Wielding Ribboncleaver causes you to move 5% slower, but take 15% less damage.
Dash forward, shrugging off the next few incoming hits, gaining knockback resistance, and causing your next attack to deal +95% damage to a single target.

items.name: Riftmane
description: Chance on swing to tear open a rift and loose a single spectral charger at a distant foe.
Split the air into a rank of spectral chargers that surge forward, goring and scattering everything in their path.
Using the ability while sprinting causes you to mount the central charger.

items.name: Righteous Relic
description: Chance on hit to regenerate health.
A growing power seems to emanate from within.

items.name: Shadowsting
description: Chance on hit to summon a shadow clone that repeats your attack.
Gain brief immunity and rapidly shadowstep between nearby enemies, striking each for weapon damage.

items.name: Slumbering Lichblade
description: Tortured souls radiate from you, damaging any nearby enemies.

items.name: Soul Pyre
description: Cause the landscape around you to shift into the nether. Slaying enemies within this malformed landscape causes it to grow larger.
Defeated enemies grant you souls, which are periodically fired as homing projectiles.
While active, you gain knockback resistance and take 50% reduced damage.

items.name: Soul Render
description: When used while sneaking, it summons Phantom Halberds in a spiral pattern

items.name: Soulkeeper
description: Two soul lanterns orbit you, damaging enemies they touch. Weapon and lantern hits increase their orbit speed.
Summon two additional soul lanterns for a short duration.

items.name: Soulrender
description: Chance on hit to inflict stacking weakening effects.
Consume all stacks from surrounding foes, damaging them and healing you relative to the stacks consumed.

items.name: Soulstalker
description: Abyssal tendrils periodically emerge from your back and pierce nearby enemies.
Rise upon six abyssal limbs to stride across the terrain. Charge jump to perform a directional leap.
While in-use, footsteps spread Gloam and damage nearby enemies, while weapon swings release shadow cleaves.
Gloam slows and latches onto enemies that linger within it. Hostile deaths feed its growth.

items.name: Soulstealer
description: Chance on hit to steal soul debt. Kills steal additional debt.
Spend all soul debt to blink behind a target and backstab them, scaling up to 5x weapon damage.

items.name: Star's Edge
description: During the day, your attacks inflict 0.155 additional damage.
At night, your attacks gain lifesteal.
Dash forward, and leave a constellation trail for a short duration.
The constellation trail damages enemies that touch it, and explodes each star for area damage when it expires.

items.name: Storm's Edge
description: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Become lightning and dash forward, gaining invulnerability and tearing through enemies before releasing a thunderclap.

items.name: Stormbringer
description: On hit, spend a Storm Charge to fire chain lightning between nearby enemies.
Focus energy to a single point of your blade, becoming briefly immune to incoming damage.
Perfectly timing this ability triggers a counterattack and grants Storm Charges.

items.name: Stormscale
description: While you have a Stormscale planted in the ground, your melee attacks trigger area damage around it.
Plant a spectral glaive at the targeted location and tether it to you.
Each melee attack you perform increases its pulse damage and radius by 1%, stacking up to 80%.

items.name: Sunfire
description: Chance on hit to regenerate health.
Summons a Righteous Battle Standard that ignites, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting strength and health to friendly players within its vicinity.

items.name: Tainted Relic
description: Chance on hit to inflict weakness.
A growing power seems to emanate from within.

items.name: Tempest
description: Your attacks attach elemental energy to the target, causing damage over time and element specific debuffs.
Return all nearby elements to yourself, forming a vortex of elemental energy around you, damaging nearby enemies and growing in size.

items.name: The Annihilator
description: If you hold it in both hands, you can charge it for 2 seconds for AOE damage

items.name: The Devourer
description: Deflecting an attack opens an abyssal maw beneath the attacker, damaging nearby enemies and dragging them inward.
A deflection near your Devouring Mass feeds it and redirects the drag toward its core.
Launch an abyssal seed that blooms into a floating, living mass at the targeted location.
The mass spreads Gloam as it lashes up to 6 nearby enemies, drags them into its core, and feeds upon them.
The mass grows as it feeds, before collapsing and releasing its captives after 40.0 seconds.
Gloam slows and latches onto enemies that linger within it. Hostile deaths feed its growth.

items.name: The Immolator
description: Critical damage to targets afflicted with Blazing Brand
If you hold it in both hands, you can charge it for 2 seconds for summon Flame strike

items.name: The Incinerator
description: Hold right click for 3 seconds to charge
When released, summons a flame strike in the direction you are facing
WARNING: Items may be lost when the flame strike explodes

items.name: The Watcher
description: Your weapon hits build up to 5 Dread on targets, summoning a bat for each stack.
A stream of bats repeatedly tear into the enemy before delivering a final attack based on the targets missing health.
At maximum Dread, enemies left below 25% health are executed.
Killing the target resets the cooldown.

items.name: Thunderbrand
description: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Charge your weapon, becoming immune to damage.
Once charged, dash through enemies and release chain lightning for each instance of damage you would have received while charging.

items.name: Tidal Claws
description: Right click to fire a grappling hook
Left click to shoot a tentacle that damages entities

items.name: Twisted Blade
description: Chance on hit to gain Ferocity, increasing attack speed and stacking up to 15 times.
While you have Ferocity, your hits can trigger Crescendo strikes that damage and knock back nearby enemies.
Consume all Ferocity to empower your next successful hit with Grand Crescendo.

items.name: Waking Lichblade
description: Tortured souls radiate from you, damaging any nearby enemies.
Command your souls to attack a distant target, dealing rapid damage. Chance to siphon health.
After the attack subsides, your souls return to you and, when reaching you, grant you absorption.

items.name: Watching Warglaive
description: Your weapon hits build up to 5 Dread on targets, summoning a bat for each stack.
Release your bats through nearby enemies afflicted with Dread. Strike and siphon life for every Dread stack consumed.

items.name: Waxweaver
description: Attacking ignited enemies grants you Strength and Haste.
When you would die, you are instead imbued with magic wax, healing you to full and granting resistance for a short time.
This effect can only occur once every 60s. Mainhand only.
Encase an enemy in wax, preventing it from moving or attacking, and causing nearby enemies to attack it.
The wax prison detonates when it expires or its victim dies.

items.name: Whisperwind
description: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Perform a swift forward dash, gaining resistance and absorption. Enemies caught in the path take damage after a short delay.

items.name: Wickpiercer
description: When you would die, you are instead imbued with magic wax, healing you to full and granting resistance for a short time.
Throw Wickpiercer, gaining frenzy stacks that grant attackspeed and allow you

items.name: Wraithfang
description: Throw Wraithfang and leap towards its position, briefly becoming immune to damage.

items.name: Wraithmaw
description: When collected, spectral cutlasses float above you, seeking targets when you swing your weapon.
Send a barrage of spectral cutlasses that leave Gloam where they land.
Gloam slows and latches onto enemies that linger within it. Hostile deaths feed its growth.
